points.description: States that a queue is a data structure that stores elements and removes them in first-in-first-out order (the first item added is the first removed; equivalently, items are removed in the order they were added).
points.partial_credit: Half or more of the marks for a vague or partly correct statement, e.g. only 'a data structure that stores elements' or FIFO described loosely or with a minor error.

points.description: Identifies it as a data structure that stores a collection of elements.

rubric.notes: Full marks: a queue is a data structure holding elements that are removed first-in-first-out, in any wording (FIFO alone with 'data structure' earns 5). Note the model answer's 'last item added will be the last removed' is the same as FIFO. Part marks for vague or incomplete statements, such as naming it a data structure without the ordering, or describing ordering with a minor error. Answers describing LIFO/stack behaviour lose P1; unrelated talk earns 0.
